## {.nostretch}

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:26px 48px 30px 48px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;">
  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.12;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;letter-spacing:-0.1px;margin:0;padding:0;white-space:nowrap;">Selected Models and Why We Used Them</h1>
  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid #d7dee8;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;margin-top:4px;">
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:330px 1fr;gap:26px;padding:19px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Multinomial Logistic Regression</div>
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">A simple linear baseline, used to check whether satisfaction can be predicted from additive effects of the features.</div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:330px 1fr;gap:26px;padding:19px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Random Forest</div>
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">An ensemble tree model, used because it combines many trees to reduce overfitting and capture non-linear patterns in the survey features.</div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:330px 1fr;gap:26px;padding:19px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Gradient Boosting</div>
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">A boosted tree model, used because it can capture feature interactions and usually works well with structured survey data.</div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:330px 1fr;gap:26px;padding:19px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Naive Bayes</div>
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">A simple probabilistic benchmark, used to test whether a fast model can provide a useful comparison point.</div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:330px 1fr;gap:26px;padding:19px 0;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Fully Connected Neural Network</div>
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">A non-linear model, used to test whether more flexible learning improves prediction beyond traditional models.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
